hero.title: Mat-IQ: Materials Intelligence & Quantum Lab
hero.tagline: Staff Scientist at Los Alamos National Laboratory — integrating first-principles methods and molecular dynamics with machine learning and quantum computing to accelerate materials discovery

about.title: Where Artificial Intelligence Meets Materials Science
paragraphs: I am a staff scientist in the Theoretical Division at Los Alamos National Laboratory, specializing in structural materials for extreme environments and functional materials for energy-to-electronics applications.
My work integrates first-principles methods and molecular dynamics with machine learning, graph neural networks, generative AI, active learning, large language models, and quantum computing.
I contribute to open data infrastructure including aNANt, JARVIS-Leaderboard, and URSA, and have authored 38+ peer-reviewed publications with an h-index of 19.
